subject: [PATCH 1/5] SUNRPC: allow a service to opt out of rpcbind registration

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch allows a service to opt out of rpcbind registration by introducing a new flag, sv_no_rpcbind, in the svc_serv structure. When this flag is set, the service will not be registered with rpcbind and the code that handles rpcbind registration will skip over it. This change does not affect any existing behavior as no caller has yet set the flag. The patch modifies three files: include/linux/sunrpc/svc.h, net/sunrpc/svc.c, and net/sunrpc/svc_xprt.c.
